---
title: "Ali Wasiyat Layi Ghazi Nu Bolaya Aye Lyrics 2024"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Najfi"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

1
Ali Wasiyat Layi Ghazi Nu Bulaya Aye
Main Aj Taun Zainab Da Pardah Tainu Banaya Aye.
Toon Nigehban Aye Ghazi Rasool De Ghar Da.
Ali Aj Apni Fazeelat Aye Tere Naa Karda.
Khuda Ne Tere Choon Ghazi Ali Wikhaya Aye.
Toon V Paband Rawin Ga Sabar Hussain Tera.
Aa Wekh Masjid-e-Kofa De Wich Sabar Mera.
Main Apne Qatil Nu Ghazi Kiwein Jagaya Aye.
Silsila Lashaan Da Ghazi Aye Hoan Rukna Nahin.
Badar, Siffeen Da Ghazi Oh Wair Mukna Nahin.
Main Sir Kata Ke Sajday Wich Khuda Bachaya Aye.
Mainu Miliya Aye Imamat Da Aye Sila Ghazi.
Mere Musallay Te Likhiya Aye Karbala Ghazi.
Rawin Taun Veraan Te Ban Ke Ali Da Saya Aye.
Qatal Ali Da Nayi Najfi Qatal Rasool Da Aye.
Madine Ujray Yaan Kofay Oh Ghar Batool Da Aye.
Jidi Qabar De Nishaan Nu Ali Mitaya Aye.
21 Ramzan Imam Ali AS Shahadat New Noha.
Noha Khuwan Party Ch Faiyaz Party Sialkot.
Matami Sangat
Anjuman-e-Sipah-e-Ahl-e-Bait Sialkot

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Updated the language metadata to `Panjabi` (`pa-Arab`, `rtl`) based on the verses’ grammar. Kept the single numbered stanza and Najfi’s in-verse takhallus. Excluded four trailing event and recitation credit lines from the poetry.

Read the ambiguous Roman forms `hoan` as `ہُن` and `veraan` as `ویراں`. Only the selected lyric was edited, and `git diff --check` passed.
